visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blue cartoon creature named Capoo, wearing a red scarf, runs energetically across a stark white background. A thought bubble appears above it showing a yellow spiral poop icon, indicating an urgent need to use the bathroom. (2) Capoo discovers a standard white ceramic toilet situated in the middle of the empty white space. The creature stops abruptly, looking relieved at the sight of the facility, preparing to settle on the seat. (3) Capoo is seen sitting comfortably on the white toilet seat. Its expression is one of calm satisfaction. The background remains a minimalist white, focusing entirely on the character and the object. (4) The scene becomes intense as blue jagged energy bolts surround Capoo while it sits on the toilet. The creature's body vibrates rapidly, and its eyes are wide, suggesting a powerful or painful physical process. (5) The setting changes to a somber graveyard under a white sky. A grey tombstone is visible with a picture of Capoo and the date "2025.12". A yellow dog wearing a black hat stands nearby as Capoo's body lies limp on the ground. (6) The scene returns to the toilet, which is now glowing with a shimmering blue light. Capoo, looking recovered, holds a large red gasoline can marked with an "X" and pours the liquid into the toilet bowl. (7) Capoo strikes a match, creating a small flicker of orange light, and drops it into the toilet. Immediately, high orange and red flames erupt from the bowl, consuming the upper half of the ceramic structure. (8) A yellow dog character jumps into the center of the flaming toilet. As it enters the fire, its yellow fur turns a deep reddish-brown color, and white steam clouds rise from its body, indicating it is being cooked. (9) Capoo stands to the side of the burning toilet, smiling widely with its tongue out. The creature appears extremely happy and satisfied with the situation, watching the flames continue to lick the air. (10) A final scene shows a hot dog sitting in a bread bun, which has the facial features of the yellow dog. It is being pushed out from a white rectangular kitchen appliance that resembles a microwave or toaster.
